aud.description: Token audience. A user access token without resource indicators carries the client id as a string; with resource indicators it carries an array of the client id and the resources.

azp.description: Client a user access token was issued to. Service tokens carry client_id instead.

error.description: OAuth error code such as invalid_request, invalid_client, invalid_grant, invalid_scope, or invalid_target (RFC 8707) for a rejected resource parameter.
